name: Tierra Del Sol Gallery
about_text: Tierra del Sol Gallery is the exhibition space of the Tierra del Sol Foundation, a Los Angeles-area nonprofit founded in 1971 that supports artists with disabilities through studio space, career development, and materials. A dedicated gallery opened in West Hollywood in 2019 to expand the foundation's programming and connect its artists with a wider audience. The gallery organizes year-round exhibitions and events, frequently inviting guest curators such as Alison Saar, Darren Romanelli, and jill moniz. Its program centers on drawing, painting, ceramics, and textile work by self-taught and outsider artists, with pieces acquired by institutions including MoMA, the American Folk Art Museum, and El Museo del Barrio. Proceeds from sales support the artists and the broader foundation.

No formal artist roster with representation status was published on the site's Artists page, which lists exhibitions rather than a represented-artist directory, so no roster entries could be confirmed.

triage.site_notes: The site organises content around a roster page (/artists) listing represented artists, an exhibitions hub with sub-sections for current, past, and off-site shows (including art fairs), and each individual show—whether in-gallery or off-site—gets its own dedicated page with dates and details since the archive/current index pages themselves list titles without dates; press/events serve as news.
